components.name: MorphingSearch
components.doc: A search icon that stretches into a field and then lets a results panel grow out of it; Escape walks the same steps back.

components.name: MorphingSearchPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: the search living at the end of an app toolbar, above a page it can cover.

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id.

members.name: title
members.doc: Main line. This is what the query is matched against.

members.name: subtitle
members.doc: Second line: where the item lives or what it does.

members.name: group
members.doc: Heading the item is listed under.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Icon shown before the title. Defaults to one that fits the sample groups.

members.name: keywords
members.doc: Extra words that should match the item. Only the title and these words are searched.

members.name: items
members.doc: Everything that can be found. Defaults to sample pages, people and actions.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the icon has grown into the field. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the search starts open when uncontrolled.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the search opens or closes.

members.name: query
members.doc: Text in the field. Pass it with `onQueryChange` to control it.

members.name: defaultQuery
members.doc: Starting text when uncontrolled.

members.name: onQueryChange
members.doc: Called with the text of the field whenever it changes.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Called with the chosen result. The search closes afterwards.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: Hint shown in the empty field.

members.name: width
members.doc: Width of the open field in px. It never grows past the space the component is given.

members.name: align
members.doc: Edge the field grows from: `end` keeps the icon's right edge in place, `start` its left edge.

members.name: shortcut
members.doc: Key that opens the search from anywhere on the page. Pass an empty string to turn it off.

members.name: limit
members.doc: Most results listed at once.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the anchor box.
